properties.description: The class test for fact:root-cause-a-constructor-wrote-its-status-only-when-the-call-settled-and-signed-whatever-it-wrote-2026-10-19: walks all nine constructors that take a `status` (add_decision, add_requirement, add_project, add_capability, add_component, add_artifact, add_verification, add_release, add_epoch), every value the schema allows, on create and on revise, with and without an approver where the tool takes one; an approver with nothing to sign is not drawn and the reply says so; an unknown status is refused and nothing is written. In the MCP crate's in_memory program.
properties.name: a_constructor_stores_the_status_it_was_given.rs — every status-taking constructor stores the status it was given
